newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Contal hits record sugar output.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Contal hits record sugar output.

text.p: Mexican bottler and sugar miller Grupo Continental (Contal), the country's second largest refined miller, produced a record total of 277,297 tonnes of sugar this closing 1996-1997 cycle, the company said on Tuesday.
The volume from the group's two mills was up 15 percent over the 1995-1996 campaign and slightly higher than original production estimates of 270,000 tonnes.
"The volume represents 6.5 percent and 17 percent of the country's total output and of the country's refined output respectively," Contal said in a statement.
Mill yields (cane to sugar ratios) increased to 12 percent against 11.6 percent last cycle, Contal added.
